digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 从真实工程师的 .agents 目录提炼的 AI 编码 Agent 技能库，让 Agent 按成熟工程实践干活

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码 Agent 按成熟软件工程方法论工作的技能框架，把开发流程沉淀为可复用技能

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 助手提供可复用的标准化能力模块，让智能体快速掌握各类专业任务

repos.name: github/spec-kit
repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with SDD or any other process!
repos.summary_zh: 帮助开发者快速落地规格驱动开发流程的Python工具包，让SDD从理念变成可执行的工作流

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: D4Vinci/Scrapling
repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EM
repos.summary_zh: 一站式 Python 网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬取全搞定，无需切换工具

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的多线程 Redis/Valkey 替代品，可直接替换且内置全文与向量搜索

repos.name: cdcailf/cjkfold
repos.description: Fold look-alike CJK glyphs (Kangxi radicals, CJK radical supplements) so text extracted from PDFs matches again.
repos.summary_zh: 将康熙部首等CJK形近字折叠归一，让PDF提取的中文文本重新可匹配，解决检索与NLP预处理中的字形不一致难题

repos.name: l-wn/ClusterChat
repos.description: A chatbot, with a large language model split across its users, entirely in the browser.
repos.summary_zh: 把大语言模型拆分到多个用户浏览器中协同推理的聊天机器人，无需服务器即可运行

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 跨会话记住一切，自动压缩历史操作并回注相关上下文，解决会话失忆问题

repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费LLM供应商共635个模型端点于单一/v1接口，支持智能路由、自动故障转移与密钥加密，月供74亿token

repos.name: wici-ai/inferssd

repos.summary_zh: 让超大 MoE 模型从 SSD 流式加载专家权重，突破内存与显存限制跑推理，基于 llama.cpp 支持 CUDA 与 Apple Silicon

repos.name: T-Crypt/berth

repos.description: Interactive explorer for learning how large language models are trained
repos.summary_zh: 交互式探索大语言模型训练全流程的可视化学习工具，把抽象训练原理变成可动手操作的直观体验

repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让任意 Hugging Face 模型一键微调、加载并部署为校准决策模型，把 Transformer 直接变成可用的决策引擎

repos.name: cjpais/Handy
repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: 完全离线运行的免费开源语音转文字应用，用 Rust 打造且支持扩展，兼顾隐私与性能

repos.name: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover
repos.description: A privacy-first app that strips AI watermarks from content you own.
repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的AI水印清除工具，帮你移除自有内容中的AI水印痕迹

repos.name: ethanplusai/sellbird
repos.description: Sellbird (formerly Harvey): the open-source outreach platform that runs on your Claude or ChatGPT plan. Finds companies and decision makers, verifies
repos.summary_zh: 基于你的 Claude 或 ChatGPT 订阅运行的获客外联平台，自动找公司决策人、验证邮箱并撰写发送个性化冷邮件

categories.name: 📦 其他热门

repos.name: denoland/deno
repos.description: A modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Rust 构建的现代 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 运行时，内置安全沙箱与原生 TS 支持，无需额外配置即可直接运行

repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs

repos.name: HKUDS/DeepTutor
repos.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.
repos.summary_zh: 港大开源的全生命周期个性化辅导系统，让 AI 导师记住你的学习轨迹并持续因材施教
